title: Creating the Agent and making the first call

cues.en: So let's begin to use the agent framework part now that we have the raw connection in place.
cues.zh: 底層連線準備好之後，現在開始使用 Agent Framework。

cues.en: What we're going to do is we're going to get a chat client which is that we can work with chat.
cues.zh: 首先取得 ChatClient，讓我們能處理對話。

cues.en: We could also use what is called the responses client which is a more advanced version of this but I tend to use the
cues.zh: 也可以使用 ResponsesClient，它是更進階的版本，不過我通常使用

cues.en: chat client because it's the most compatible version with all providers and here and here we need a model.
cues.zh: ChatClient，因為它和各家供應商的相容性最好。這裡還需要指定模型。

cues.en: For this course I will use some very very cheap models so you don't spend a lot of money while you're trying out this
cues.zh: 課程中我會使用費用非常低的模型，避免你在練習時花太多錢。

cues.en: but let's quickly go and see what models we have available.
cues.zh: 先快速看看有哪些模型可以使用。

cues.en: So we can go to the dashboard up here and we can see the different models up here.
cues.zh: 到上方的 Dashboard，就可以查看各種模型。

cues.en: I will use the model called chat-gpt5-nano so this is the name that we're gonna put in here.
cues.zh: 這裡會用到 gpt-5-nano 模型，把模型名稱填進來。

cues.en: chat-gpt5-nano.
cues.zh: 也就是 gpt-5-nano。

cues.en: It's a very very cheap model but it's more than capable of what we need to do in these samples.
cues.zh: 這個模型非常便宜，但已經足以應付這些範例。

cues.en: Of course in real life you might have more advanced stuff you do with the AI and need bigger models but this is more than capable.
cues.zh: 實務上你可能會用 AI 做更進階的事情，需要更大的模型，但這裡已經夠用了。

cues.en: And what we can now say is create AI agents and if we do that we
cues.zh: 現在可以呼叫 CreateAIAgent，這樣就會

cues.en: get what is called a chat client agent from Microsoft agent framework.
cues.zh: 得到 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 ChatClientAgent。

cues.en: The agents we can now use to talk with the LLM and we do that using something called RunAsync.
cues.zh: 我們可以透過這個代理程式和 LLM 對話，方法是呼叫 RunAsync。

cues.en: So we need the await keyword and we need to ask something and that could be what is the capital of France.
cues.zh: 因此需要 await 關鍵字，再問個問題，例如「法國的首都是哪裡？」。

cues.en: If we do that we get something called an agent run response back and that agent one response we can simply just write out
cues.zh: 呼叫之後會拿到 AgentRunResponse，可以直接把回應輸出到

cues.en: into the console.
cues.zh: 主控台。

cues.en: We can take the entire object because the two string will just be the same as what is called text here and this is
cues.zh: 可以直接輸出整個物件，因為 ToString 的結果和這裡的 Text 屬性相同。這其實就是

cues.en: actually everything that needs to be here.
cues.zh: 所需的全部程式碼了。

cues.en: We don't need the hello world from this and we just have our API key, our raw client, our agent, our call to the
cues.zh: 不需要原本的 Hello World。現在有 API 金鑰、底層用戶端、代理程式，以及對

cues.en: LLM and we should be able to run.
cues.zh: LLM 的呼叫，應該就可以執行了。

cues.en: So let's do that and let me move
cues.zh: 來執行看看，我先把

cues.en: system over here and we get the answer back that it's Paris.
cues.zh: 視窗移到這裡，就能看到回傳的答案是巴黎。

cues.en: What we have here is a thinking model so the answers will be a bit slow at times.
cues.zh: 這裡使用的是推理模型，所以有時回應會比較慢。

cues.en: I will also draw these using a non -reasoning model which is the chat gpt-4.1-nano in this case as well and
cues.zh: 我也會示範非推理模型，這裡改用 gpt-4.1-nano。

cues.en: what we will be able to see if I run this is that the answer comes back much faster.
cues.zh: 執行之後就能看到，答案回傳得快很多。

cues.en: What we also saw that an AI is non-deterministic so the first time I just said the word Paris the second time I said the capital of France is Paris.
cues.zh: 同時也可以看出 AI 具有非決定性：第一次只回答「巴黎」，第二次則回答「法國的首都是巴黎」。

cues.en: So that is actually everything there is to getting started.
cues.zh: 要開始使用，其實就只需要這些。

cues.en: From here on it's more just building more and more on top of this which we'll do in the following videos.
cues.zh: 接下來就是在這個基礎上逐步增加功能，後續影片會繼續介紹。
